title: Settings
resetConfirm: Are you sure you want to reset all settings to their default values?

about.description: Desktop viewer and report generator for Dutch CPT (Cone Penetration Test) data. Built on the OpenAEC Foundation visual identity.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.intro: Optional modules — turn on what you use. Changes take effect immediately (no restart needed).

tekening.title: Site plan
tekening.description: Adds the 'Site plan' tab — CAD paper (A2/A3) with CPTs on a map, frame, scale bar, snapping, overlays and export to PDF.

offertes.title: Request quotes
offertes.description: Adds the 'Request quotes' button to the site plan ribbon (requires the site plan extension). Opens a dialog with the nearest CPT contractors and a pre-filled quote request by e-mail.
